content:
The image shows a leaf with irregular, light brown lesions, some of which appear sunken and coalescing. There are also darker, dried areas on the leaf edge, suggesting necrosis or dieback. This pattern of lesions and tissue death is consistent with fungal diseases like Anthracnose. Powdery Mildew typically presents as white, powdery growth, and Sooty Mould as black, superficial fungal growth, neither of which are clearly visible here. While there is some dieback, the primary and most distinct symptom is the anthracnose-like lesions.
